content: Admission Inquiry Research & Innovation Patents & Intellectual Property Fostering an ecosystem of invention and intellectual property creation by our visionary faculty and brilliant students. 48 Total Patents 13 Granted 17 Published Institutional Support Intellectual Property Rights Cell The Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell fosters innovation and safeguards intellectual assets developed by students, faculty, and researchers through structured guidance and legal support. With in-house Registered Patent Agents of the Indian Patent Office, along with attorneys and IPR advisors, the cell ensures that intellectual contributions from campus are protected and effectively utilized for academic, commercial, and societal benefit. Awareness and Education Conducts workshops, seminars, and training programs to build understanding of patents, trademarks, copyrights, and design rights. IP Filing Assistance Guides students, faculty, and researchers through patent, copyright, and trademark filing procedures for timely legal protection. Innovation Encouragement Creates an IP-friendly ecosystem that motivates research, entrepreneurship, and idea development with confidence in ownership rights. Collaboration and Networking Supports engagement with industry and academic partners to help move innovations toward real-world application and commercialization. The IPR Cell focuses on both protection and responsible utilization of intellectual assets generated at KPGU.
